items.description:
Transducer Developments Co, trading as Loadcell Services, describes itself as the largest supplier of South African-manufactured load cells, with most of its range available for delivery from stock to meet South African market needs. Beyond standard load cells, the company designs custom units for applications needing specialised force measurement, and also specialises in torque and pressure transducers.

Its instrumentation division designs, manufactures and supplies load cell instrumentation for the process automation industry, covering process control and force measurement applications such as static weighing, conveyor weighing and overload protection on cranes and conveyors. The company has particular depth of experience in the iron and steel industry, where its instruments are used for roll-force measurement and monitoring strip tension, drawing on a long-serving technical team based in The Willows, Pretoria.

Travel Counsellors SA - Mbali Skosana is an independent travel counsellor based in Centurion, specialising in tailor-made travel with particular expertise in Japan, Thailand and the United Arab Emirates, as well as family holidays, group trips, solo travel and ocean cruises. Clients get a personalised service built around their own trip, from the first idea for a destination through to arriving home with the holiday booked.

Rather than working from a fixed storefront, Skosana runs a mobile business model, meeting clients wherever is most convenient, whether that's at their office, at home or at a coffee shop, and also assists with business travel arrangements. This flexible, one-on-one approach suits clients who want a dedicated consultant managing their holiday or corporate travel rather than booking everything themselves online.

Triniti Business Solutions brings 30 years of operational competency, 14 years of project, programme and portfolio management (PPPM) experience and seven years of business analysis expertise to its enterprise ICT consulting work. The firm has delivered projects in the mining, medical and financial sectors for clients including Lonmin Platinum Mines, Goldfields (where it won an innovation award for its PSo Strategy-Projects-Operations software solution), the Medical Research Council, Netcare 911, Standard Bank, Nedbank, Investec and ABSA.

Its leadership sits on the SABS ISO technical committee for project, programme and portfolio management and has served as Vice President of Project Management South Africa, and the firm is a Gold Certified Training Partner for PMSA. Its education and training courses, covering both PMBOK and BABOK methodologies, are used by the University of Pretoria's ICT department, Rissik Business School and Atio Netcampus International, with UNISA's Department of Computer Science also deploying the coursework.

Tutor Trust has provided estate administration, sequestration, liquidation and corporate insolvency services across South Africa for more than two decades, and describes itself as one of the largest insolvency agencies in the country by number of appointments. The practice is organised into distinct divisions: an Estate Administrators Division handling the day-to-day running of estates from appointment through to final release, staffed by employees holding the Diploma in Insolvency Law prescribed by SARIPA.

A separate Financial Division manages all financial aspects of each estate, drawing on a combined total of more than 30 years of bookkeeping experience among its staff, while a support team of receptionists, assistants, filing clerks and messengers keeps the administrative side running. Based in Rietondale, Pretoria, Tutor Trust places particular emphasis on training and mentoring its employees, aiming to keep only well-qualified personnel across its divisions.

Ukuvuma Solutions has provided managed IT services since 2004, bringing together Microsoft 365, Azure and private cloud, business networking, Sophos firewall protection and 3CX business telephony as a certified Microsoft Partner. Rather than treating these as separate products, the company positions itself as one technology partner connecting day-to-day support with cloud, security and communications so the whole environment works together.

Its engagement approach runs through four steps: understanding a client's organisation, goals and concerns; assessing the systems, support arrangements and risks involved; prioritising urgent issues against longer-term needs; and improving the environment through a dependable, supported implementation plan. Operating from Zwartkop, Centurion, Ukuvuma Solutions serves South African organisations wanting practical, proactive IT support rather than reactive, one-off fixes.

USN Head Office is the South African headquarters of USN, a sports nutrition brand whose product range spans proteins, pre-workouts, creatine, mass gainers, fat burners, hydration products and weight-loss shakes. Among its best-selling lines are BlueLab 100% Whey Protein, Hardcore Whey gH and gH Ripped, Hyperbolic Mass gH gainer, Diet Fuel Ultralean, Pure Creatine and a Super-Immune Hydrator, alongside a dedicated USN x Plato range developed in partnership with the Plato brand.

Products are organised around specific training goals, from endurance and weight-loss support to testosterone boosters and everyday protein bars and snacks, giving customers a single nutrition brand to shop across different fitness objectives. Based at Louwlardia Logistics Park in Centurion, USN Head Office oversees the brand's South African product range and distribution from this site.

VEA Road Maintenance and Civils has been ranked among the top five companies in South Africa's construction sector for three consecutive years, 2023 to 2025, delivering road rehabilitation and routine maintenance work for clients including the South African National Roads Agency and the Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport. Its services span planning and development, road maintenance and repair, project engineering, civil construction works and specialised earthworks.

The company is a Level 1 B-BBEE participant with 100% Black ownership, and has built its approach around strong client relationships aimed at seamless, stress-free service delivery, alongside efforts to boost employment equality and empower the communities it works in. Operating from Heuweloord, Centurion, VEA Road Maintenance and Civils has also picked up multiple industry awards for its work.

VFV Attorneys was founded in 1979 and has grown into a law firm of five partners, three consultants, and a team of associates, candidate attorneys and professional support staff, backed by a digitally proficient call centre for client service. Its core practice centres on corporate and commercial law, supported by family law and general litigation, covering commercial agreements, the acquisition or disposal of businesses and shareholdings, dispute resolution, and insolvency and restructuring matters.

The firm's cross-border work focuses particularly on import and export matters, including customs, excise control, tariff classifications and valuation disputes, reflecting a philosophy the firm sums up simply: if its advice keeps clients in business, clients keep the firm in business. Based in Ashley Gardens, Pretoria, VFV Attorneys also offers boardroom facilities for hire alongside its legal services.

Vonmet (Pty) Ltd was established in 2016 in Pretoria as an independent metallurgical consultancy, built on more than 60 years of combined experience in the life and condition assessment of high-energy plant components. The company is considered one of the leading providers of this kind of assessment in South Africa, working on pressure equipment, boilers and other plant components across the power generation, mining and petrochemical industries.

Vonmet's head office is in Pretoria, with satellite offices in Middelburg, Mpumalanga, and Sasolburg in the Free State, and the company partners with Sebenzana Consulting to support clients such as Sasol, Sappi, Mondi and Kelvin Power, as well as with inspection firms including DEKRA Industrial RSA to support Eskom, Elca Engineering and MAN Turbo. Its expertise spans failure investigation, remaining life assessment, and total asset integrity management for industrial clients across South Africa.

Vox Pretoria is a branch of Vox, a South African telecommunications and connectivity provider serving homes and businesses across the city. The branch connects customers to fibre, LTE, 5G and voice and VoIP services, alongside cloud, hosting and other business technology solutions, giving customers a single point of contact for connectivity and the technology that runs alongside it.

As part of the wider Vox network, the branch draws on the group's national infrastructure and support resources while handling enquiries, installations and account support for customers in and around Menlyn. It operates from the 2nd Floor of Block B, Corobay Corner, on Corobay Avenue in Menlyn, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, serving residential customers who need reliable home connectivity and businesses looking for a dependable technology partner.

Water-Wise has supplied, installed, serviced and repaired reverse osmosis and ultrafiltration systems, along with pure water and mineral pot dispensers, for domestic and industrial clients since the company was established in Gauteng in 2003. Describing itself as a small company dedicated to the details of good service, it has built its reputation on helping clients access cleaner drinking water.

The business frames its purpose around South Africa's particular water challenges: with average rainfall of only 464mm a year, many areas rely on recycled wastewater, and contaminants from industrial and mining activity, farming chemicals and informal settlements can all find their way into tap water, compounded by limited capacity at water treatment plants. Based in Monavoni, Centurion, Water-Wise positions its filtration and purification systems as a direct response to these conditions for households and industrial sites alike.

Waterkloof Mansion Boutique Hotel offers guest accommodation in a mix of luxury rooms and self-catering options, each with free Wi-Fi, and welcomes guests with a daily breakfast included in their stay. Guests can relax around an outdoor swimming pool or in the garden and outdoor seating areas, and the property can arrange private massages, manicures and pedicures for those wanting extra pampering during their stay.

Free parking is available on site, and the boutique hotel's garden setting gives it a quieter, more residential feel than a typical city hotel. It is located on Victoria Street in Waterkloof, Pretoria, close to the Pretoria Country Club and the British and US ambassadorial residences, and does not accommodate children, making it a better fit for couples, business travellers and guests seeking a calm, adults-focused stay.

Weavind & Weavind Inc is a law firm whose practice traces its history back to 1905, giving it more than 120 years of experience in South African legal practice. The firm's attorneys, notaries and conveyancers cover a broad range of work, including corporate and commercial law, commercial litigation, property law, employment and labour law, insurance and banking matters, construction law, criminal law, conveyancing, notarial services, insolvency and dispute resolution.

That combination lets the firm act for both individual and corporate clients across most of the legal matters a business or private client is likely to face, rather than referring work elsewhere. Weavind & Weavind Inc has been based at Block E, Glenfield Office Park on Oberon Avenue in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, since moving there in 2014, continuing a practice with roots reaching back more than a century.

Webcafe (Pty) Ltd positions itself as a one-stop IT partner, combining professional IT support and management with website design, marketing strategy and hardware sales for small businesses in and around Constantia Park, Pretoria. Its IT managed services cover hardware and software, network and internet solutions, while its online shop sells laptops, desktops, Apple products, printers and cartridges directly to customers.

On the software side, Webcafe helps businesses set up Office 365, Business Central, CRM and ERP systems alongside financial software, and its marketing offering extends to website builds, hosting with ongoing support, and improving a client's visibility on social media. Appointments can be scheduled at a client's office or online, letting Webcafe tailor its support to how each business prefers to work.

WebScripto Pty Ltd designs and builds responsive, custom-built websites for businesses and organisations, including business websites and e-commerce stores, along with ongoing website maintenance and content writing to keep a site current once it's live. The company also assists clients with domain registration and hosting advice, and offers on-page SEO work to help a website perform better in search results.

Rather than running a walk-in storefront, WebScripto operates by appointment, meeting clients either onsite or online to work through a project from initial build to the smaller updates that follow. Based in Montana Park, Pretoria, the company serves businesses and organisations throughout South Africa, giving them a single point of contact for a website build and the maintenance, hosting and search visibility work that comes after it goes live.

items.reason: Follow-up research found only a thin Canva-built site repeating the existing one-page mover/furniture-transport blurb; current independent information is too limited to reliably expand the supplied description of services, customer base or operating history. Held pending a deeper pass.

items.description:
West Kennett Corporation, trading as Westken, has manufactured and supplied resistance welding equipment and consumables since it was founded in June 1984. Its range covers spot-welding guns, transformers, pedestal welders, projection welders and seam welders, along with the consumables these machines need, as well as welding machines and welding-control and timer systems covering MIG, TIG and ARC welding processes.

Production takes place at the company's Rosslyn plant, which combines CNC and conventional machining facilities with its own paint shop and fabrication shop, employing around 30 personnel across roughly 3,000 square metres of floor space. Based at 190 Van Eden Crescent in Rosslyn, Pretoria, West Kennett Corporation draws on more than four decades in the welding equipment industry to supply both equipment manufacturers and workshops needing reliable resistance and arc welding machinery.

Westside Trading 448 runs an all-inclusive turnkey property development process in Midstream Estate, Centurion, starting with a consultation to establish exactly what a client wants to build or renovate. From there, the company can secure land it already owns or has sourced from a third party, handling the building plans and Local Council and Homeowners Association approvals needed before construction can begin.

The process continues through close relationships with established Gauteng-based architects and structural engineers, full project costing and detailed drawings, before moving into actual construction, client briefings along the way, and interior design and finishing touches. This end-to-end structure lets clients watch their new home or renovation take shape from the initial idea through to a finished, move-in-ready property.

Wollies Animal Shelter started in 2003 with the initial goal of sterilising as many animals as possible, before growing into a broader non-profit, pro-life shelter that takes in abandoned, neglected and abused cats and dogs. It receives no government funding, and every animal stays with the shelter until a forever home is found, reflecting its belief that affordable, accessible sterilisation is the key to reducing the number of homeless and abused animals.

Alongside its sterilisation and castration programme, historically offered at R350 per pet, the shelter also provides a microchipping service for R150, registering each chip on the Identipet database, with all adopted cats and dogs microchipped and registered as standard. Based in Hesteapark, Pretoria North, it is open Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Saturday from 9am to 4pm, and Sundays from 9am to midday, closed on Wednesdays.

Wolvaardt Inc Attorneys has grown since its founding in 1995 into a firm offering a comprehensive range of legal services from its Moreleta Park offices in Pretoria. Its practice areas span commercial law, legal recoveries and debt collection, litigation and mediation, insolvency law, property law and conveyancing, family and matrimonial law, and work on estates, trusts and personal injury claims.

The firm also provides notarial services and takes on correspondent work for other law firms needing local representation in the Pretoria area, giving it a role supporting both direct clients and fellow practitioners. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, excluding public holidays, with after-hours and Saturday consultations available strictly by appointment for clients who can't make standard office hours.

Wood@Ease supplies a wide range of solid and semi-solid wooden cupboard doors and components to contractors, kitchen designers and interior decorators working on kitchens and interiors. Beyond doors, its product range covers solid wooden tops, exposed panels, turned legs, cornices, lightshields, mouldings and floating shelves, available across a wide range of wood types, finishes and thicknesses.

Clients can start a quote directly online before placing an order, and the company has built a loyal base of repeat trade customers in the kitchen and cupboard design industry. Based in Donkerhoek, Wood@Ease is open Monday to Thursday from 7:15am to 4:15pm and Fridays from 7:15am to 3pm, closed over weekends, serving businesses across the greater Pretoria area.

Xpress Batteries Clubview supplies batteries for a wide range of vehicles, including cars, trucks, tractors, leisure vehicles and golf carts, as part of the Willard Battery Xpress network. Alongside selling replacement batteries, the branch offers battery testing to check whether an existing battery still has life left in it, along with battery fitment and delivery for customers who need their vehicle back on the road without delay.

Operating from Von Willich Avenue in Centurion, the branch draws on the backing of the wider Willard Battery Xpress network while handling day-to-day battery sales, testing and fitment for customers in Clubview and the surrounding Centurion area. This makes it a practical option for motorists and operators of trucks, tractors and leisure vehicles alike who need a battery replaced or tested quickly.

Xpress Batteries Wolmer, trading locally as Willard Battery Xpress Pretoria North, sells automotive and industrial batteries along with battery replacement services for customers who need a new battery fitted. The branch also runs a battery recycling service, giving customers a way to dispose of an old battery responsibly when they come in for a replacement.

Shopping is done in-store, with staff on hand to help customers choose the right battery for their vehicle or equipment and fit it on the spot. Based at 625 President Steyn Street in Wolmer, Pretoria, the branch forms part of the Willard Battery Xpress network, giving motorists and businesses in Pretoria North a nearby option for automotive and industrial battery needs, from new purchases to safe disposal of old units.

Yachties4Yachties offers visa assistance for aspiring superyacht crew, helping clients apply for B1 B2 visas, Schengen visas, seafarer documentation and other visas needed to work on yachts around the world. Its Start Yachting Package was designed by captains, bosuns and yachting instructors to equip newcomers with the qualifications and hands-on experience the industry expects.

Through its Go 2 Sea Packages, the company guides people who want to become a yachtie but aren't sure which courses to take, while its Complete Offshore Training service helps clients get on the water and working toward a yachting career. Based in Shere, Pretoria, and open daily from 9am to 5pm, Yachties4Yachties serves clients across South Africa working through the visa and training requirements of international yacht crew work.

Yanfeng Automotive Interiors Rosslyn forms part of a global automotive interior and vehicle-component manufacturer, with the local operation trading under the names Yanfeng Global Automotive Interiors South Africa and Yanfeng IAT SA. Current trade records link the Rosslyn site to the production and supply of automotive parts, including vehicle seats and related interior components, alongside ongoing import activity tied to its manufacturing work.

The plant supports automotive manufacturers and the wider vehicle-production supply chain, supplying components that feed into vehicles built in South Africa and beyond. Based at Building B1, 30 Helium Road in Rosslyn, Pretoria, Yanfeng Automotive Interiors Rosslyn operates within one of the country's established automotive manufacturing hubs, keeping its production and import activity aligned with the needs of the vehicle assembly plants it serves.

Yeet Marketing describes itself as an all-in-one marketing partner for South African brands, offering influencer marketing, media buying, digital marketing strategy and in-house content and design production. The agency has worked with a wide range of clients across different industries, including USN, SkyNet, Duramat and the Blueberry Hill Hotel, alongside smaller specialist brands in sectors from construction to biomedical supply.

Its positioning leans into a bold, no-nonsense approach, aiming to make every campaign brief a competitive opportunity rather than a routine deliverable. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Yeet Marketing works across these different client sectors to produce marketing precise and purposeful enough to stand out, rather than blending in with standard agency output.

23 on Hazel is a street-vibe cafe and restaurant serving breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner throughout the day, alongside coffee and a full bar for those settling in for a drink. The menu includes vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options, giving different dietary needs a place at the same table rather than a separate limited menu.

The cafe has built up more than 110 reviews on Tripadvisor from diners who have visited over the years, reflecting a steady local following. Located on Hazelwood Road in Hazelwood, Pretoria (also referenced in some listings under the adjoining suburb of Menlopark), 23 on Hazel suits anyone looking for an all-day spot to eat, have coffee or settle in at the bar.

2Moro's eat & drink Bistro is a cafe and bistro known for its own coffee beans, alongside Italian olive oil and vinegar, fresh ciabatta bread and a selection of sweet treats made in house. The space also displays and sells local artwork, giving the bistro a gallery feel alongside its food and coffee offering.

Beyond its day-to-day menu, the bistro caters for events including team lunches, corporate meetings, birthdays, baby showers and game nights, making it a venue option for groups as well as individual diners. Based at Shop 10 in the Montana Value Centre on Tecomaria Street, Montana, Pretoria, 2Moro's eat & drink Bistro serves both regular customers dropping in for coffee and groups booking the space for a private event.

items.reason: Follow-up research found current listings for a tree felling, garden maintenance, landscaping and paving business generally in the Pretoria/Amandasig area, but the supplied Wingate Park address could not be independently confirmed -- a different area than what was found. Held pending address verification before publication.

items.description:
3D Print Lab positions itself as one of South Africa's pioneering 3D print shops, stocking printers, filaments and spare parts from brands including Creality, Elegoo, SA Filament and FilX. Its filament range covers common types such as PLA, ABS and PETG, giving hobbyists, educational institutions and businesses the materials needed for a wide range of 3D printing projects.

Beyond selling hardware and consumables, the company runs beginner training courses aimed at building customers' confidence to assemble and operate their own 3D printer, positioning itself as a partner in a customer's 3D printing journey rather than just a retailer. Based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, and open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm and Fridays until 4pm, 3D Print Lab serves the hobbyist, education and business 3D printing market across the city.

Accountants in Motion (AIM) operates through a set of specialist divisions covering different financial needs: AIM for Compliance for regulatory and statutory compliance, Audit in Motion for independent assurance led by IRBA-registered professionals, Accountants in Motion itself for integrated accounting, payroll and compliance work, and Advisors in Motion and AIM Wealth for business, personal and wealth advisory services.

This divisional structure lets the firm offer technology-supported solutions across compliance, audit, accounting, payroll, tax and wealth planning under one group rather than through separate specialist firms. Beyond its Pretoria branch in Lynnwood Glen's Glen Gables office park, AIM also operates offices in Benoni and Middelburg, giving clients across these regions access to the same integrated range of financial services.

ACMC Group of Companies has supplied commercial vehicle parts for more than 30 years, since its establishment in 1994, now stocking more than 22,000 items across more than 700 product categories for trucks, buses and trailers. Its range covers brake systems, driveline solutions and workshop services, including products manufactured to recognised standards such as IATF 16949, the quality standard behind its own LWL 403 brake drum for heavy-duty trailer applications.

The company provides national fleet support from its Pretoria West base as well as a Standerton location, aiming to keep South Africa's commercial fleets operating safely, efficiently and profitably. ACMC Group of Companies specialises particularly in brake friction products, clutch kits, and suspension and transmission parts for the trucking and bus industries across the country.

Adendorff Machinery Mart has traded since 1990 and now runs 30 stores nationwide, selling tools and machinery including air compressors, air tools, hand tools, power tools, pumps, generators, welding and woodworking equipment, and even meat-processing machinery. Its MAC AFRIC house brand covers everyday workshop tools such as cordless impact wrenches, router trimmers, die grinders and surface cleaners, sold alongside other recognised brands.

Customers can apply for Adendorff Trade Credit for larger or ongoing purchases, and bulk orders can be quoted on request, alongside the standard nationwide delivery service. This Pretoria branch, on the corner of Steve Biko and Adcock Street in Gezina, is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays until 1pm, selling tools and machinery direct to tradespeople and the public.

Advance Cash & Carry Hermanstad is a wholesale grocery and FMCG retailer stocking a broad range of everyday goods, from food staples and beverages to pet food, household products and personal-care items. Its current promotional catalogues list specific lines including flour, milk, coffee, cereals, beans and margarine for the kitchen, dog and cat food for pet owners, and soft drinks and household products rounding out a typical weekly shop.

Trading from the corner of Moot Street and Es'kia Mphahlele Drive in Roseville Park, Hermanstad, the store positions itself as a bulk-buying option for households and smaller retailers looking to stock up on groceries and FMCG goods in one trip. Regularly updated catalogues keep its range and pricing current for shoppers watching for the best deals on everyday essentials.

items.reason: Follow-up research could not independently verify the supplied description of stainless-steel bakkie canopies from a reliable current source; the business and address appear in directory listings but without independent product information. Held pending a deeper pass.

items.description:
Africa Scrap Recyclers buys and recycles both ferrous metal, such as iron, steel and scrap vehicles, and nonferrous metal including aluminium, copper, brass and wire, paying cash to the public, scrap dealers, auction houses and mines who bring material to its yard. A regularly serviced and calibrated weighbridge ensures suppliers get accurate value for what they bring in, whether it's a small household drop-off or a larger commercial load.

Beyond buying and reselling scrap, the company also trades second-hand industrial conveyor belts and steel, and offers onsite demolition and waste removal, bin placement and collection, and product tracking services, with an onsite canteen for staff and visiting customers. The yard in Zandfontein, Pretoria West, runs six days a week, Monday to Thursday from 7am to 4pm, Fridays until 3pm and Saturdays until 1pm.

Africa Timber Marketing has more than 15 years of experience manufacturing Saligna, hardwood and horizontal slatted doors and door frames, trading as ATM, a name the company says is now synonymous with quality in South Africa's door manufacturing industry. Its product range includes Saligna back-to-back doors, frame and ledge open-back 'Z'-braced doors, and Class E, 30-minute Firelab-approved fire doors for both exterior and interior use.

The company also produces exterior horizontal marine plywood doors and Saligna door frames in medium and heavy-duty specifications, built around a stated focus on quality, service and competitive pricing. Based in Rayton, Africa Timber Marketing supplies architects, builders, contractors and hardware retailers across Gauteng looking for door and door-frame products at affordable prices.

African Spares supplies new and used engine, suspension and body parts for cars and bakkies from its premises on Es'kia Mphahlele Drive in Pretoria. Its engine department stocks used OEM engine parts and complete engines, while the suspension side covers full suspension systems or individual components such as steering racks, stabiliser links and drive shafts.

For body work, the company supplies replacement panels including boot lids, doors, bonnets, windows and loading bins, as well as full body sections and rolling chassis for more extensive rebuilds. Customers can reach the business directly by phone, WhatsApp or social media while its official website remains under construction, keeping the focus on getting vehicles back on the road rather than online browsing.

AfriMedia is a 100% black-owned turnkey media agency offering experiential brand activations, content creation, digital marketing, event curation and project management under one roof. As part of the Afrimedia Group and Afrittude Communications, it also draws on wider group expertise in conference, event and experiential marketing to put together campaigns and activations from concept through to delivery.

Its client base spans businesses, government departments, NGOs and other corporate organisations, reflecting an agency built to handle both commercial brand work and public-sector communication needs. Based at 1036 Olympus Drive in Olympus, Pretoria East, AfriMedia positions itself as a single agency able to plan, create and manage a campaign or event from the first idea through to the activation itself.

AgriBonus is a farmer loyalty rewards programme that lets members earn points by supporting its network of partner companies, chosen as experts within and outside agriculture to offer products members actually want. Those points can be redeemed for exclusive holidays, electronics, household appliances and camping gear, among other rewards, or donated to a cause of the member's choice.

Members who prefer to give back can direct their points to causes such as the Endangered Wildlife Trust's rhino rescue efforts or the Agri Relief Foundation, which supports farmers facing tragedies like fires or farm attacks. Co-operatives and Toyota dealers both recognise AgriBonus membership when members make qualifying purchases. Based in Lydiana, Pretoria, and open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4pm and Fridays until 3pm, AgriBonus continues to build its partner network around members' everyday agricultural purchases.

Agriplas Centurion manufactures and sells irrigation equipment with a primary focus on the agricultural sector, alongside industrial water filtration products and supplies for the mining industry, including materials for heap leaching, dust suppression and mine rehabilitation. The company has been in business for more than 40 years, selling through a large network of agents across South Africa as well as exporting to customers abroad.

Its own Gulf range covers micro sprinklers, inline valves and automation equipment, while distribution agreements with brands including Amiad, Metzerplas, Senninger, ITC, Nutricontrol and Rivulis extend its range further into drip irrigation, filtration and fertigation equipment. Based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, Agriplas supplies both agricultural and industrial customers needing irrigation, filtration or water-management equipment and parts.

Agua é Vida Willow Way offers 7-stage purified mineral water through a walk-in refill station at Shop 27, Willow Way Centre in Die Wilgers, where customers can refill their own 5L, 10L, 20L or 25L bottles. The business also delivers, with rental water dispensers available from R259 a month, including free installation, a lifetime warranty and instant swap-outs if a unit needs attention.

Subscription options let customers set up regular at-home refills of 20-litre bottles or dispensers without needing to visit the store each time, and the range extends to related health products such as Himalayan fine salt. As part of the wider Agua é Vida network, the Willow Way branch gives Pretoria East customers both an in-store refill option and ongoing home delivery for purified water.

Aka Design (Pty) Ltd is a freelance interior design consultancy with over a decade of experience in residential interior decoration and design. Its work covers kitchen and bathroom renovations, bedroom design and custom home layouts, giving clients a single point of contact for planning and finishing a room or an entire home.

The practice serves homeowners directly, as well as contractors and architects who bring it in to handle the interior design side of a broader building or renovation project. Based on Barn Owl Street in Amberfield, Centurion, Aka Design works across both small renovation jobs and larger custom home layouts, suiting clients who want an experienced interior designer involved from early planning through to the finished space.

Akani Systems takes what it calls a rigorous approach to IP services implementation, combining best-in-breed products with its own technical skills to build practical communications solutions for African businesses. Its core offering includes tailor-made VoIP solutions priced around what a business actually needs, along with the design, deployment and maintenance of unified communications systems built to be cost-effective, flexible and reliable.

The company also runs a custom software development practice covering the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and ongoing maintenance, and positions itself as a trusted partner for businesses needing CIO or CTO-level technology management support. Operating from Midstream Estate, Centurion, and open Monday to Saturday from 8am to 5pm, Akani Systems combines network infrastructure, connectivity and software development under one roof for clients across the region.

Aldes Business Brokers Pty Ltd is part of the established Aldes brokerage network, helping clients buy and sell businesses across a wide spread of sectors rather than specialising in just one industry. Current listings handled through the network have included an established plumbing and leak-detection business in Cape Town, a flame-grill chicken takeaway in Paarl, a children's science-show entertainment business, a recurring web-hosting client book built over more than eight years, and a fresh produce distribution business with its own cold-chain logistics and warehousing.

This range, from small owner-operated businesses to multi-million-rand operations, reflects the brokerage's reach across retail, food service, technology and logistics sectors. Operating from Midfields Estate, Pretoria, Aldes Business Brokers offers free business valuations to business owners considering a sale, and helps buyers find businesses for sale matched to their budget and interests.

Alkaline Ionized H₂0 supplies pH9 alkaline mineral oxygen-enriched water and pH10 alkaline ionized mineral water, alongside reverse osmosis filter servicing, water dispensers, filters and personalised bottled water from its premises in Clubview Corner Shopping Centre. The business, under the same ownership and product range it has offered for years, positions its water as a wellness product beyond simple hydration.

Customers can also get refills on all water bottles and containers from 5 litres upward, with office and home delivery available alongside in-store sales. It is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, closed Sundays, serving Centurion residents and businesses looking for alkaline or purified drinking water close to home.

Alphabelle is an insurance broker in Hazeldean, Pretoria East, specialising in liability cover tailored for professional businesses, including professional indemnity, medical malpractice and directors and officers liability insurance. The brokerage positions itself as a partner that understands the ever-changing challenges professionals face around indemnity and liability risk, rather than offering generic, one-size cover.

Alphabelle says it conducts business with integrity, in a fair, open and honest manner and in full compliance with its legal obligations as a licensed financial services provider. Clients can request a quote directly to explore which of its liability products best covers their specific professional risk, making it a dedicated option for businesses needing specialised indemnity and liability insurance rather than general commercial cover.

AMERICAN shutters and Security Pretoria is a Castle Walk Shopping Centre showroom for the American Shutters brand, which has served South Africa since 1985. The range covers aluminium shutters such as the AS-Sentinel, AS-Elite and AS-Edge lines, wooden shutters including DecoWood and the waterproof Woodberry range, and fixed louvre systems, all custom-made to suit local conditions and available in an extensive choice of materials, colours and finishes.

Products are tailored to specific areas of a home, with dedicated shutter ranges designed for bathrooms, bedrooms, kitchens and living areas, as well as exterior applications including gates and louvres. AMKHOIB Contractor Consultants protects construction businesses from costly safety violations and workplace incidents, handling health and safety documentation, compliance and risk management so contractors can focus on delivering their projects.
